title: Sell Mineral Rights in Englewood, CO
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Englewood, CO | Arapahoe County
metaDescription: Hold severed minerals under or near Englewood, Arapahoe County? We confirm title and make a direct written offer, no listing required.
heroLead: Englewood is fully developed Denver-metro suburb today, but a surprising number of owners still hold mineral rights that were severed from the surface generations before the neighborhood existed.
intro: Severed mineral ownership is common across older Arapahoe County subdivisions, usually dating back to farmland sold off in the mid-twentieth century where the seller kept the mineral estate as a hedge against future value. Most current owners inherited these interests without much documentation and are not sure what, if anything, they are worth.

The honest answer depends entirely on whether the tract sits inside an active DJ Basin drilling unit. Some Englewood-area minerals are pooled into horizontal units reaching in from nearby pads; others have never been leased at all.

sections.heading: First step: confirming the severance and unit status
paragraphs: We search Arapahoe County deed records against your legal description to confirm the mineral severance is real and, if so, whether it has been leased or pooled into a unit. This single step resolves most of the uncertainty owners have about whether their interest is worth pursuing.

sections.heading: What an offer letter actually includes
paragraphs: When we send a written offer on an Englewood-area interest, it states the price, the specific legal description and net revenue interest we are buying, and the basis for the number, whether that is a decline curve or comparable unleased sales. Nothing is left vague, and you are free to have anyone review it before signing.

sections.heading: If you are already receiving royalties
paragraphs: If checks have been coming in, we price your interest off that trailing production using a standard decline curve, the same approach we use for any producing DJ Basin tract, urban or rural.

sections.heading: If you have never leased or produced
paragraphs: Undeveloped minerals under developed suburban surface carry real but more speculative value, since drilling directly beneath a neighborhood is unlikely but a horizontal well from elsewhere could eventually reach it. We price this scenario conservatively against comparable unleased sales.

faqs.question: I inherited this and have no paperwork at all. Can you still help?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can search Arapahoe County records using your name and any legal description you have to confirm what you own.

faqs.question: Can a well actually be drilled in Englewood?
faqs.answer: Unlikely on developed surface, but horizontal laterals from pads outside the neighborhood can reach the mineral estate underneath without any surface disturbance here.

faqs.question: Is this interest worth pursuing if I've never received a check?
faqs.answer: It can be, though value is lower than producing acreage. We would rather give you an honest range than overstate it.

faqs.question: Is there any obligation once I get an offer?
faqs.answer: None. You can accept, decline, or simply ask questions with no pressure to move forward.
